## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user of the published snapshot.

## Validation

State the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish deterministic tests
from live microphone, model, GPU and desktop checks. Explain any untested limits.

## Review notes

Mention affected contracts, permissions, dependencies, documentation and material
AI assistance where relevant.

- [ ] The change is focused on the public snapshot and preserves component boundaries.
- [ ] Relevant behavior changes have regression coverage and the full quality gate passes.
